fod-strip.text: Horizontal three-panel newspaper strip, clean and readable. Consistent cream masthead reading exactly 'The Forces of Darkness, LLC.' with separate strip title. Bold inked outlines, clean repeatable silhouettes, muted plum/brick/olive/gold palette, simple flat shading, readable deadpan acting, spacious unobstructed speech balloons. Preserve body-size hierarchy (Hork far larger than Eric), established outfits, and exact supplied dialogue and speaker ownership. The evil occupation, dungeon, curses, raids or army infrastructure remains visibly real. Keep a balanced comic rhythm; let the final panel deliver the authored reversal. Each strip stands alone, without invented story continuity.
